info.title: EkMaap onion grading API
info.description: SIH26031 - photo-based onion grading. Prototype: see docs/ for limits.

post.description: Upload one photo of the lot's sample (on the printed mat). Runs the pipeline and returns the analysis.

get.description: Lot result right now: latest analysis of every photo, officer reviews applied, active rule set.

post.description: Freeze the lot result into a fingerprinted report. Onions still 'Needs review' block issuing.
Run the CURRENT active models again (new analysis row; old ones are kept).
Officer's decision on one onion (confirms or corrects the model). Latest review wins.

get.description: Public: is there an issued report with this fingerprint? (What the QR code on the PDF encodes.)

post.description: Public: recompute the fingerprint of a record (and optionally of photos) and compare with what was issued.
Add a photo for training/evaluation (not linked to a lot). split_group = e.g. capture day.

put.description: Replace ALL ground-truth labels of a photo (polygons in original photo pixels).

post.description:
Suggest outlines + conditions with the active models (faster than drawing). save=true stores them as
annotations (source=prelabel) - a labeller must still check them.
Assign train/val/test by photo (or by split_group). Stable: a photo keeps its split when more are added.

get.description:
ZIP with images/, annotations.json (COCO, categories = conditions, per-image split) and ruler.csv -
exactly what the scripts/train_*.py and scripts/evaluate.py expect.

post.description:
Import corrected labels from CVAT / Label Studio (COCO). Images are matched by file name to the
uploaded photo's original name (or to '<photo id>.<ext>' from our own export). Replaces their labels.
Register a trained model file (from scripts/train_*.py). It is test-loaded before it is accepted.
Evaluate the ACTIVE models + rule set on labelled photos of a split (synchronous; keep test sets modest).
